description: WhatsApp is introducing usernames, allowing users to chat without sharing their phone numbers. Once available, you will be able to choose a unique username from the Settings menu and share it instead of your mobile number. Usernames are optional and can be changed later without affecting your chats. WhatsApp has started testing the feature with some Android and iPhone users. A broader rollout is expected later in 2026, giving users more control over how others can find and contact them.
title: Hide Your Number on WhatsApp: How to Set a Username for Better Privacy

description: NASA’s Perseverance rover photographed a strange rock formation on Mars that appears to show three stacked rocks. Scientists believe wind and ancient water activity likely shaped the unusual structure over millions of years.
title: Mysterious Stacked Rocks Spotted by NASA Perseverance Rover on Mars

description: Meta has silently listed a new Forum app on Apple's App Store. This new social networking platform is designed to work like Reddit. Users can sign in to the Forum app using their Facebook account. The Forum app is compatible with devices running on IOS 18.0 or later. It has an AI-based assistant. It lets users post with a nickname, and it is 109.2MB in size.
title: Meta Launches Forum App as a Reddit-Like Platform for Discussions With AI-Powered Assistant for Admins

description: The HMD Vibe 2 5G, Redmi A7 4G, and Lava Yuva Star 3 target budget smartphone buyers with different priorities. HMD offers 5G connectivity, a 120Hz display, and a 50-megapixel camera. Redmi focuses on long software support, a brighter 120Hz display, expandable storage, and a 6,300mAh battery. Lava undercuts both rivals on price while delivering a clean Android Go experience, a 90Hz display, and a 5,000mAh battery for everyday use.
title: HMD Vibe 2 5G vs Redmi A7 4G vs Lava Yuva Star 3: Price in India, Specifications and Features Compared

description: Xiaomi 17T series will be launched in select global markets in two display variants, the smartphone maker announced on Friday. Additionally, the smaller phone is confirmed to be offered in at least a Violet colourway, while the larger variant will arrive in at least a Deep Blue shade. However, both models are shown to feature the same design. The two handsets will sport a Leica-tuned triple rear camera system, housed inside a square-shaped camera island. An LED flash appears next to the deco, placed in the top-left corner of the flat rear panel.
title: Xiaomi 17T Series Teased to Arrive in Two Display Variants; Colour Options Revealed Ahead of Debut

description: Google and Samsung showcased their next-generation smart glasses at the Google I/O 2026. Although the two companies plan to release both audio AI glasses as well as display-equipped smart glasses, the first will be released in the market this year. Just days after the showcase, a market intelligence firm has claimed that Google could sell more than two million units of its Android XR-powered smart glasses.
title: Google Might Sell Over 2 Million Android XR-Powered Smart Glasses This Year: Report

description: The Honor Magic 9 series is rumoured to be in development as the successor to the Magic 8 lineup, which was unveiled in October 2025. In recent months, the rumour mill has suggested that the next-generation lineup could offer significantly improved batteries over the current models. A tipster has reiterated the claims, suggesting that the Honor Magic 9 series, which might include at least three models, will feature significantly larger batteries.
title: Honor Magic 9 Series Could Feature 8,000mAh Batteries; Tipster Leaks Camera, Display Upgrades

description: During thPixel Glow, that would work alongside Gemini.e Google I/O 2026 Keynote, Google may have teased the Pixel Glow feature. In a video of Gemini Omni, a model was seen holding what appeared to be a Google Pixel 11 smartphone, and at the end, the area around the phone's camera bar briefly glows. This is likely to be a reference to the feature. The Pixel Glow feature is expected to debut alongside the Google Pixel 11 series, which will go official later this year with the Tensor G6.
title: Google's Pixel Glow Feature for the Google Pixel 11 May Have Accidentally Leaked During Google I/O 2026

description: iQOO 16 has reportedly appeared on the IMEI database, indicating that the smartphone could be moving closer to launch. According to a new report, the listing references the handset by its marketing name and hints at launches in India and global markets. Leaks suggest that the device may feature Qualcomm's upcoming Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro+ chipset, a periscope telephoto camera, advanced cooling technology, and a 9,000mAh battery. The handset is expected to succeed the iQOO 15.
title: iQOO 16 Global and Indian Debut Seemingly Confirmed as Handset Gets Listed on IMEI Database: Report

description: Realme has launched the Buds Air 8 Pro in India alongside the Realme 16T and Realme Watch S5. The TWS earbuds feature an 11mm dynamic driver and a 6mm micro-planar tweeter, LHDC 5.0 Hi-Res wireless audio, and adaptive ANC with up to 55dB noise reduction. They also offer a six-microphone calling system, Bluetooth 6.1 connectivity, 45ms low-latency gaming mode, dual-device pairing, IP55-rated protection, and up to 50 hours of total battery life with the charging case.
title: Realme Buds Air 8 Pro Launched in India With Up to 55dB ANC, Up to 50 Hours of Total Battery Life: Price, Features

description: Apple's rumoured MacBook Pro model with an OLED display launch seems imminent, as Samsung reportedly plans to start the mass production of its 8.6th generation OLED panels as early as June. The report added that the South Korean tech giant recently achieved over 90 percent yield with its 8.6th generation OLED panels, which are expected to be used by Apple for its MacBook Pro model with OLED display. Samsung reportedly estimates to supply about 2 million units of the OLED panel.
title: MacBook Pro OLED Panels to Enter Mass Production Next Month as Anticipated Launch Draws Close: Report

description: The next Call of Duty game will be the "definitive Modern Warfare" title, developer Infinity Ward has said. The studio said it had started a "new chapter" with two new studio heads and teased the next Call of Duty game, which is rumoured to be Modern Warfare 4.
title: Infinity Ward Working on Next Call of Duty, Says It's Making 'Definitive Modern Warfare' Title

description: Oppo Reno 16 has surfaced on the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) certification website, TUV SUD website, and the UAE's Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority (TDRA) website. The listings indicate that the handset will be released in multiple international markets outside China soon. The Chinese variant of Reno 16 is confirmed to ship with a triple rear camera unit. It will launch in China on May 25.
title: Oppo Reno 16 Bags BIS, TUV SUD and TDRA Certifications That Hint at Imminent Global Debut

description: Motorola Edge 70 Pro+ will be equipped with a 50-megapixel primary rear camera, offering a Sony LYT-710 sensor and 3.5-degree optical image stabilisation, the smartphone maker confirmed on Friday. It is also teased to feature a curved display, similar to the one found on the Motorola Edge 70 Pro. It will also sport a hole punch display cutout, which is likely to sport a camera for selfies and video calls. The phone is teased to also offer up to 50x digital zoom, enhanced by Motorola’s “Super Zoom Pro” feature.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Pro+ Camera Details Confirmed, WIll Arrive in Three Colourways

description: Samsung has been rumoured to be exploring smartphones beyond traditional form factors. Following its success with the book-style and clamshell-design handsets in recent years, leaks have indicated that it is also developing a wide foldable, widely known as the Galaxy Z Fold Wide. A newly discovered patent now suggests that the South Korean technology conglomerate is working on a rollable handset with an expanding display. The device is said to feature a movable rear camera module that shifts position as the phone expands.
title: Samsung Patent Document Hints at Galaxy Smartphone With Expanding Display, Movable Camera System

description: Realme has launched the Realme 16T in India with a 6.8-inch 144Hz LCD display, MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset, and an 8,000mAh battery with 45W SuperVOOC charging. The smartphone features a 50-megapixel Sony IMX852 main camera, a 16-megapixel selfie camera, and several AI-powered imaging tools. It also offers Hi-Res Audio support, IP69-rated dust and water resistance, military-grade shock protection, and a vapour chamber cooling system. The handset starts at Rs. 29,999 and is available in three colours.
title: Realme 16T Launched in India With 50-Megapixel Main Camera, 8,000mAh Battery: Price, Features

description: Samsung appears to be expanding the One UI 8.5 update to more old flagship smartphones and tablets. It is said to be available for the Galaxy S24 series and the Galaxy S23 series in India. Samsung said to have started rolling out the stable version of One UI 8.5 to its mid-range smartphones, Galaxy A56 and Galaxy A36. The stable update brings several Galaxy AI features that were first introduced with the Samsung Galaxy S26 series.
title: Samsung's One UI 8.5 Update Rolls Out to Samsung Galaxy S23, Galaxy A56 and More Devices

description: The OTT platforms are ready to hit your digital screens with a fresh set of releases, including Dhurandhar Raw and Uncut, The Mummy, Desi Bling, and more.
title: New OTT Releases This Week (May 18 - May 24): Dhurandhar: Raw and Uncut, Desi Bling, System, Warrant, and More

description: Grand Theft Auto 6 release date has been reaffirmed by Take-Two in its Q4 FY 2026 earnings call. The game will launch on November 19, 2026, the company said. Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick once again confirmed that marketing for GTA 6 will begin this summer.
title: Take-Two Confirms GTA 6 Launch Date Again, Says Marketing Campaign Will Begin This Summer

description: Bharti Airtel’s new priority network service for postpaid users is said to have come under scrutiny. The service, launched in India earlier this week, aims to provide access to fast lane connectivity even in high traffic demand situations, leveraging 5G network slicing. According to a report, the Centre and the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) are examining whether the offering complies with the country’s net neutrality framework.
title: Airtel’s Priority Postpaid Service Reportedly Faces Regulatory Scrutiny Over Net Neutrality Concerns

description: Google is quietly restructuring the Gemini app’s usage limit. After adding a weekly limit and releasing the new usage dashboard earlier this week, the Mountain View-based tech giant is now adopting a compute-based usage limit approach. Ditching the existing message-based count means users’ usage will now be measured by the number of tokens they consume, which can significantly reduce their actual usage.
title: Gemini Users Left Frustrated as Google Shifts to Compute-Based Usage Limits

description: Realme Watch S5 launched in India today in two colour options. It has a 1.97-inch display and is claimed to offer up to 20 days of battery life in a single charge. It offers blood oxygen (SpO2) saturation monitoring and heart rate monitoring. The Realme Watch S5 supports more than 110 sports models and has Bluetooth calling support. It is priced at Rs. 7,999 in India.
title: Realme Watch S5 Launched in India With 1.97-Inch AMOLED Display, Up to 20 Days Battery Life

description: Realme 16T 5G comes with various downgrades over its predecessor. But it remains a decent choice for most users who are looking for a phone in its price range. The Realme 16T 5G’s 8,000mAh battery offers impressively long screen-on time, and the 45W charging support is quick enough, too. The smartphone can also take passable photos for your social media feed. Overall, it is a fine device, and its design really helps it stand out from the competition, giving it a sharp edge.
title: Realme 16T 5G Review: The Pro Looks at an Affordable Price

description: A new leak on Reddit suggests that the Oura Ring 5 will be announced on May 28, and the pre-orders for the wearable will begin on the same day. The launch is said to take place on June 4, and the deliveries of the ring will also begin on the same day. The new model will reportedly retain the health-tracking features and membership benefits of the Ring 4
title: Oura Ring 5 Leak Hint at Imminent Launch; Could Offer Same Health-Tracking Features as Ring 4

description: Portronics Vayu Nano, the company’s latest compact-sized tyre inflator, has been launched in India. The tyre inflator is currently on sale in the country via Amazon and the Portronics India online store. The portable device is offered in a single Black colour option. Portronics says that its new tyre inflator can inflate flat tyres of two-wheelers, including motorcycles and bicycles, and deflated sports equipment, including basketballs and footballs, electronically. The Portronics Vayu Nano delivers up to 120 PSI pressure.
title: Portronics Vayu Nano Tyre Inflator Launched in India With Up to 120 PSI Pressure, 600mAh Batteries: Price, Features

description: HMD Thunder Pro has surfaced in a fresh leak that reveals its design and key specifications ahead of any official announcement. Renders shared by a tipster show a flat-frame design with a horizontal rear camera module. The handset is tipped to feature a 6.67-inch full-HD+ OLED display, a Unisoc T620 chipset, 8GB RAM, and 256GB storage. Other leaked details include a 6,000mAh battery, a 50-megapixel primary camera with OIS, NFC support, dual speakers, and an IP65 rating.
title: HMD Thunder Pro Design Renders Leaked Online Alongside Key Specifications

description: Xiaomi 17T will be launched in India on June 4, the tech giant has confirmed. The handset will be the first T series handset to debut in the country in years, as last year’s Xiaomi 15T and Xiaomi 15T Pro were not launched in India. The new Xiaomi 17T will be unveiled in India a week after the launch of the Xiaomi 17T series in select global markets on May 28. Globally, the lineup is expected to include the Xiaomi 17T and Xiaomi 17T Pro. Recently, a report claimed that the company will not bring the Pro to India. Leaked specifications suggest that the Xiaomi 17T will be powered by an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 8500 Ultra chipset.
title: Xiaomi 17T India Launch Date Announced; Will Arrive a Week After Global Debut

description: Samsung is reportedly developing the Galaxy Buds Able, a clip-style open-ear wireless earbud that sits on the ear instead of sealing the ear canal, according to a report. The report supports earlier leaks and suggests the earbuds could launch alongside Samsung's next foldable smartphones. The Galaxy Buds Able is expected to use air-conduction audio technology and target users who want greater awareness of their surroundings. Samsung would enter a growing market that already includes products from Huawei, Bose, Sony, Anker, and Xiaomi.
title: Samsung Preparing to Launch Galaxy Buds Able as Clip-On Open-Ear Earbuds: Report

description: The Oppo Reno 16 series is set to launch in China soon as the successor to the Reno 15. In the days leading up to the launch, the company has been teasing select details about the upcoming handsets. The standard Oppo Reno 16 has now surfaced on a benchmarking platform, revealing its moniker and some of its key specifications. It is said to be powered by a MediaTek chipset. The Oppo Reno 16 appears to run on Android 16.
title: Oppo Reno 16 Chipset Details Surface via Geekbench Listing; May Feature Dimensity 8500 Chip, 12GB RAM

description: The Redmi Note 15 series was launched earlier this year. The lineup in India, which previously comprised the standard model, a Pro variant, and the Note 15 Pro+, was recently expanded with the introduction of the Redmi Note 15 SE 5G. A recent listing on a certification platform indicates that its successor, the Redmi Note 17 series, may already be in development. The listing not only confirms the existence of the handset but also suggests that the company could unveil the Redmi Note 17 lineup earlier than expected.
title: Redmi Note 17 Reportedly Spotted on GSMA Database; May Launch Earlier Than Expected
